name: Can I prevent storm damage to my home?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent storm damage to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's impossible to prevent all storm damage, you can take steps to reduce its impact. Regularly inspect and maintain your roof, gutters, and downspouts to ensure proper water drainage. Trim trees and remove dead branches near your home to prevent falling hazards during high winds. Secure loose outdoor items. Consider reinforcing windows or investing in storm-resistant doors. These proactive measures can significantly lower the risk of severe damage and help protect your property during inclement weather. Even with precautions, severe storms can cause unexpected damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can reduce storm damage by maintaining your roof, gutters, and trimming trees. Securing outdoor items and reinforcing windows also helps, though complete prevention isn't possible.
